ja: 漫画『ULTRAMAN』より「ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5」がFigure-rise Standardに登場！
• 本体表面の銀色はエクストラフィニッシュ、赤色はグロスインジェクションで質感を再現。
• 専用のLEDユニットが付属し、目を光らせることが可能。
• 「ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5」の主要武装のほか、原作者・清水栄一氏デザインの「EYE SLUGGER」がオリジナル武器パーツとして付属。
• 「EYE SLUGGER」は両手に携行することが可能。
• ２つの「EYE SLUGGER」を合体させることができるジョイントパーツが付属。
en: "ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5 " from the manga " ULTRAMAN" is now available in Figure-rise Standard!
• The silver color on the main body surface is extra finish, and the red color is gloss injection to reproduce the texture.
• A dedicated LED unit is included, allowing you to keep an eye on it.
• In addition to the main weapons of "ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5 ", " EYE SLUGGER" designed by the original author Eiichi Shimizu is included as an original weapon part.
• "EYE SLUGGER" can be carried in both hands.
• Comes with joint parts that can combine two "EYE SLUGGER".
